source.document: Geometric Aspects of Bin Grids, version 2.3 (2020-04-04), Bert Kampes (Shell)
source.note: The note states that the example values of its Table 1 and Table 2 do not correspond spatially to each other or to its figures.

four_point_example.description: Table 1: four-point (loadsheet) definition with example values. Left-handed: the inline axis (A to C) points to the left of the crossline axis (A to B).

p6_example.description: Table 2 and the P6/11 header records: right-handed grid, inline axis bearing 92.48019694 and crossline axis bearing 2.48019694 degrees, written as EPSG method 9666.
